subtitle.zh: 把 KV 缓存复用变成可验证的系统能力
subtitle.en: Make KV reuse measurable and reproducible

description.zh: 从缓存身份、独立缓存服务到分层存储和故障回退，用对照实验回答 LMCache 何时有价值。10 天完成一个有边界、有原始证据的工程作品，不承诺生产精通。
description.en: Study cache identity, the standalone cache service, storage tiers, and failure handling. Build controlled experiments that explain when LMCache is useful, ending with an evidence-backed portfolio rather than a promise of production mastery.

hoursPerDay.zh: 每天 2–3 小时；安装、模型下载与硬件排错另计
hoursPerDay.en: 2–3 hours a day; installation, model downloads, and hardware debugging are extra

prerequisites.zh: 理解 prefill/decode、KV cache 与基本 Python；能使用一个推理引擎并阅读容器日志。建议先完成 vLLM 或 SGLang 课程。
prerequisites.en: Understand prefill/decode, KV cache, and basic Python. Be comfortable with one inference engine and container logs. Complete the vLLM or SGLang course first.

hardware.zh: 真实引擎集成需受所选版本支持、能容纳模型的设备及足够主机内存。无 GPU 可完成缓存模拟、身份测试和配置审查；CPU-only MP/共享内存路径以当前官方支持为准。网络缓存实验额外需要两个本地进程或受控节点。
hardware.en: Real engine integration needs a supported device that fits the model and sufficient host memory. Without a GPU, complete cache simulations, identity tests, and configuration reviews; consult current support for CPU-only MP/shared-memory paths. Network experiments need two local processes or controlled nodes.

zh: 推理性能工程师
缓存系统工程师
AI Infra 平台工程师
en: Inference performance engineer
Cache systems engineer
AI infrastructure platform engineer

outcome.zh: 交付固定版本的集成清单、冷/热对照实验、缓存身份测试、分层容量模型与故障报告；明确区分真实推理、缓存服务实验和模拟结果。
outcome.en: Deliver a pinned integration manifest, cold/warm comparisons, cache identity tests, a tier-capacity model, and a failure report. Clearly separate real inference, cache-service experiments, and simulations.

lesson.zh: LMCache 复用的是模型计算产生的 KV 状态，不是通用的回答文本缓存。推理引擎仍负责计算与调度，缓存组件负责把可复用状态取回或存到合适位置。先区分引擎内的本地前缀缓存、独立 LMCache 服务和后端存储，才能解释命中来自哪里。当前主线文档围绕独立 MP 服务展开，旧的进程内教程不能直接拼接到新部署中。
lesson.en: LMCache reuses KV state produced by model computation; it is not a generic cache of answer text. The inference engine still owns computation and scheduling, while the cache component retrieves or stores reusable state. Distinguish the engine's local prefix cache, the standalone LMCache service, and storage backends before attributing any speedup. Current mainline documentation centers on the MP service, so legacy in-process examples should not be mixed into a new deployment without checking their compatibility.

task.zh: 画一张请求、token、KV 状态在引擎与 MP 服务之间的流向图。选定一个引擎、模型与文档版本，列出三个可能的缓存命中位置及各自可观察的证据。
task.en: Draw request, token, and KV-state flows between the engine and MP service. Choose one engine, model, and documentation version; list three possible cache-hit locations and the evidence available for each.

evidence.zh: architecture.md：组件图、责任表、版本选择与三个可证伪的缓存假设。
evidence.en: architecture.md with a component diagram, responsibilities, version choices, and three falsifiable cache hypotheses.

zh: 明确区分文本响应缓存与 KV 缓存
图中标注本地缓存、MP 服务、存储后端
记录尚未验证的兼容性假设
en: Distinguish response-text caching from KV caching
Label local cache, MP service, and storage backend
Record compatibility assumptions that remain unverified

noGpu.zh: 用箭头图和一个 token→KV 键值字典演示读写流程；标注字典只是教学模型，未执行推理。
noGpu.en: Use a diagram and a token-to-KV dictionary to illustrate reads and writes. Label the dictionary as a teaching model, not executed inference.

lesson.zh: 集成可用性不能只用两个包的版本号判断。设备运行时与二进制 ABI、引擎加载连接器的方式、模型和并行布局的支持情况都要匹配。一次安装成功只证明进程能启动；一次请求成功也不证明缓存写入和取回生效。先把环境固定，再分别验证健康、普通推理和缓存链路，后续才能把性能变化归因到实验变量。
lesson.en: Compatibility is more than a pair of package version numbers. Device runtime and binary ABI, connector loading, and support for the model and parallel layout must all align. A successful installation proves only that processes can start; one successful request does not prove cache storage or retrieval. Pin the environment first, then validate health, ordinary inference, and cache activity separately. This makes later performance changes attributable to experimental variables instead of an unnoticed environment change.

task.zh: 按官方 quickstart 选择一条支持的 MP 集成路径。保存运行时、引擎、LMCache、连接器路径、模型 revision、dtype、block size 与并行配置；逐项验证启动与一次请求。
task.en: Choose one supported MP integration path from the quickstart. Record runtime, engine, LMCache, connector path, model revision, dtype, block size, and parallel configuration; verify startup and one request separately.

evidence.zh: environment.json、脱敏启动日志与最小复现说明；失败也需记录错误阶段。
evidence.en: environment.json, redacted startup logs, and a minimal reproduction guide; record the failure stage if setup fails.

zh: 版本与模型 revision 均具体可复现
分别记录健康检查、请求结果和缓存链路状态
不把未运行的配置写成已验证
en: Pin exact versions and model revision
Record health, request outcome, and cache-path status separately
Never mark an unexecuted configuration as verified

noGpu.zh: 审查官方配置与依赖清单，生成兼容性检查表；环境支持时运行官方 CPU-only 服务路径，否则用配置审查代替并写明限制。
noGpu.en: Review the official configuration and dependency manifest. Use the documented CPU-only service path when supported; otherwise submit a configuration review with explicit limitations.

lesson.zh: 相同文字不一定产生相同 token，相同 token 也不代表可跨任意模型共享 KV。模型权重、分词方式、布局和影响计算的配置可能改变状态含义。缓存身份的职责是让正确状态被复用，并让不兼容状态隔离；它也不是用户授权机制。先建立正例与负例，再对照当前实现的身份字段，避免把自制哈希当成生产协议。
lesson.en: Identical text does not always produce identical tokens, and identical tokens do not make KV state portable across arbitrary models. Weights, tokenization, layout, and computation-affecting settings can change what the state means. Cache identity enables compatible reuse and separates incompatible state; it is not a user authorization mechanism. Start with positive and negative examples, then compare them with the current implementation's identity fields rather than treating a homemade hash as a production protocol.

task.zh: 制作身份测试矩阵：相同输入重复、单个 token 改变、模型 revision 改变、布局改变、租户授权变化。逐项写明应命中、应隔离或需要额外访问控制，并与文档核对。
task.en: Build an identity matrix covering repeated input, one changed token, a changed model revision, layout changes, and tenant authorization changes. Classify expected reuse, required separation, or additional access control, and check against the documentation.

evidence.zh: identity-cases.csv，至少 8 个用例；附上实现字段与课程假设的差异说明。
evidence.en: identity-cases.csv with at least eight cases and a note separating implementation fields from course assumptions.

zh: 至少包含 3 个不能安全复用的反例
区分状态兼容与访问授权
未把教学哈希宣称为 LMCache 的实际键格式
en: Include at least three unsafe-reuse counterexamples
Separate state compatibility from access authorization
Do not present a teaching hash as LMCache's actual key format

noGpu.zh: 实现只操作字符串与字节的身份测试器，给每个预期结果写断言；结果只能证明测试器行为。
noGpu.en: Implement an identity checker using strings and bytes, with assertions for expected outcomes. Its results demonstrate only the checker.

title.zh: 证明命中确实来自 LMCache
title.en: Prove where a hit came from

lesson.zh: 第二次请求更快，可能来自模型预热、内核缓存或引擎内部的前缀缓存，不能单独证明 LMCache 生效。实验需要冷态、可复用热态和明确绕开本地命中的状态，并结合取回计数、字节量及时间线。先验证返回正确性，再看 TTFT。不同引擎清理缓存的接口不同，必须采用所选版本的官方方式，不能把清理请求失败当成冷态。
lesson.en: A faster second request may reflect model warmup, kernel caches, or the engine's own prefix cache rather than LMCache. Design cold, reusable-warm, and local-cache-bypass conditions, then combine retrieval counters, byte counts, and a timeline. Verify response correctness before interpreting TTFT. Cache-clearing interfaces differ across engines and versions; use the documented method for the selected release. A failed clearing request does not establish a cold condition, and a missing metric does not automatically mean zero activity.

task.zh: 固定输入 token 长度、输出上限与并发，比较冷态、普通重复、清理引擎本地缓存后重复三组，每组至少 3 次。保存服务取回证据；若接口不支持清理，用文档允许的隔离进程方案并说明代价。
task.en: Fix input token length, output cap, and concurrency. Compare cold, ordinary repeated, and repeated-after-local-cache-clear conditions at least three times each. Save server retrieval evidence; if clearing is unsupported, use a documented isolated-process approach and explain its cost.

evidence.zh: runs.csv、缓存状态重置步骤与证据截图或日志；结论允许是没有收益。
evidence.en: runs.csv, cache-reset steps, and metric or log evidence; a valid conclusion may be no benefit.

zh: 三组实验只有缓存状态这一主要变量
每次运行有取回证据或明确的证据缺口
报告至少 3 次重复的分布及正确性检查
en: Use cache state as the main variable across the three conditions
Record retrieval evidence or its absence for every run
Report at least three repeats and correctness checks

noGpu.zh: 用三层字典和固定访问序列模拟命中归因，输出各层 hit/miss；标注延迟为自设参数，不报告真实 TTFT。
noGpu.en: Simulate hit attribution with three dictionaries and a fixed request trace. Report per-layer hits and misses; label latency as assumed and do not claim real TTFT.

lesson.zh: 缓存通常按块组织状态。块越小，部分复用可能更灵活，但键、查找、传输和管理开销也可能增加；块越大，可能减少请求数，却让短前缀的复用受到边界影响。容量预算不能只用模型参数量推算，还要考虑 token 数、层数、KV 头、元素字节、并行分片与元数据。先给出假设，再用实际指标校正估算。
lesson.en: Cached state is organized into chunks. Smaller chunks can make partial reuse more flexible but may add key, lookup, transfer, and management overhead. Larger chunks can reduce request counts while changing reuse at prefix boundaries. Capacity estimates need token counts, layer counts, KV heads, element bytes, parallel sharding, and metadata rather than model parameter count alone. State the assumptions first, then calibrate them with observed storage usage. A theoretical estimate is useful even when it does not predict every implementation detail.

task.zh: 制作 KV 容量计算表，写明每个维度的来源。仅在当前连接器支持的范围内比较两个块配置，或者模拟块边界下可复用 token 数；记录容量、命中与请求开销。
task.en: Create a KV-capacity worksheet with sources for each dimension. Compare two chunk configurations only where the current connector supports them, or simulate reusable tokens at chunk boundaries. Record capacity, hits, and request overhead.

evidence.zh: capacity.csv 与一页块大小决策；至少包含一个短前缀和一个长前缀案例。
evidence.en: capacity.csv and a one-page chunk-size decision, including both a short-prefix and a long-prefix case.

zh: 计算注明单位与分片假设
变化的配置先通过兼容性检查
能解释命中率提高却未必更快的原因
en: State units and sharding assumptions
Check compatibility before changing configuration
Explain why a higher hit rate may not be faster

noGpu.zh: 为长度为 120、1000、8000 token 的访问序列模拟块边界，分别计数可用 token、键数量和假定元数据开销。
noGpu.en: Simulate chunk boundaries for traces of 120, 1,000, and 8,000 tokens; count usable tokens, keys, and assumed metadata overhead.

lesson.zh: 把 KV 从设备移到主机或外部存储可以扩大可用容量，但命中仍需付出查找、排队、传输和装载成本。是否划算取决于这些成本能否小于重算 prefill，以及是否增加资源争用。文件系统、远端存储和内存后端各有不同故障与容量特性。先比较同一工作负载，再把带宽、对象大小、并发和命中率作为敏感性变量。
lesson.en: Moving KV state from a device into host or external storage can expand capacity, but a hit still pays lookup, queueing, transfer, and loading costs. It helps only when these costs beat recomputing prefill without creating unacceptable contention. Filesystem, remote, and memory backends also have different failure and capacity properties. Compare the same workload first, then vary bandwidth, object size, concurrency, and hit rate in a sensitivity analysis. Never interpret storage capacity alone as evidence of an inference speedup.

task.zh: 从官方支持列表选两个你能访问的后端，绘制读写路径与失败点。用测得或明确标注的假定参数计算重算/取回交叉点，并对其中一个后端做小规模读写正确性测试。
task.en: Choose two accessible backends from the supported list and map read/write paths and failure points. Calculate the recompute/retrieve break-even point using measured or clearly assumed parameters, then run a small correctness test on one backend.

evidence.zh: tier-costs.csv、路径图与校验和记录；将假设值和测量值分列。
evidence.en: tier-costs.csv, a path diagram, and checksum records; separate assumed values from measurements.

zh: 包含查找、传输和排队成本
两个后端使用相同对象与访问序列
结论说明带宽下降或命中降低时是否成立
en: Include lookup, transfer, and queueing costs
Use identical objects and access traces for both backends
State whether the conclusion survives lower bandwidth or hit rate

noGpu.zh: 用本地内存字典与临时文件保存相同字节对象并校验；文件实验只代表该电脑的 I/O，不代表生产远端存储。
noGpu.en: Store identical byte objects in a dictionary and temporary files and verify checksums. The filesystem experiment measures only this computer's I/O, not production remote storage.

title.zh: 让跨实例复用保持正确

lesson.zh: 多个 worker 共享存储，能够提高已有状态被再次使用的机会，也会扩大错误配置的影响范围。生产设计必须同时处理状态兼容、命名空间、访问权限、容量竞争和生命周期。缓存键相同不能代替租户认证；worker 重启后是否仍有可用对象也取决于后端。先用相同模型与布局建立可控共享，再逐项加入不兼容或过期情况。
lesson.en: Shared storage gives multiple workers more chances to reuse existing state, while widening the impact of misconfiguration. A sound design considers compatibility, namespaces, authorization, capacity contention, and lifecycle together. Matching cache keys do not replace tenant authentication, and objects surviving a worker restart depends on the storage backend. Establish controlled sharing with the same model and layout first. Then introduce incompatible and expired cases one at a time, recording whether separation is enforced or remains an unverified requirement.

task.zh: 设计 A 写入、B 取回的两实例实验，并增加模型 revision 不同、过期/驱逐、无权限访问三个反例。仅使用自己控制的测试数据与服务；权限机制未实现时写入缺口清单。
task.en: Design a two-instance experiment where A stores and B retrieves state. Add changed-model, expired/evicted, and unauthorized-access counterexamples. Use only controlled data and services; record gaps when authorization is not implemented.

evidence.zh: sharing-matrix.csv 与隔离设计，列出每个条件的预期、实测和待验证状态。
evidence.en: sharing-matrix.csv and an isolation design showing expected, observed, and unverified outcomes for every condition.

zh: 至少有一个成功共享与三个反例
不兼容状态没有被宣称可安全复用
权限与命名空间分别讨论
en: Include one successful-sharing case and three counterexamples
Do not claim incompatible state is safe to reuse
Discuss authorization separately from namespaces

noGpu.zh: 运行两个本地进程或两个字典客户端，使用临时存储模拟共享、驱逐和拒绝访问；不要把应用层模拟当成 LMCache 的安全保证。
noGpu.en: Use two local processes or dictionary clients with temporary storage to simulate sharing, eviction, and denied access. Do not present the application-level simulation as a LMCache security guarantee.

title.zh: 区分缓存复用与 P/D 传输

lesson.zh: prefill/decode 分离要把一次请求刚生成的 KV 交给 decode，而缓存复用是在之后的请求中避免重复计算。两者都移动 KV，却有不同生命周期、时延预算与失败后果。连接器、引擎和后端并不自动支持任意组合。先画出一次请求与跨请求两条时间线，再判断 LMCache 在所选版本里承担存储、取回或传输中的哪部分。
lesson.en: Prefill/decode disaggregation hands freshly computed KV state to a decode worker for the same request. Cache reuse avoids repeated computation in later requests. Both move KV, but their lifetimes, latency budgets, and failure consequences differ. Connectors, engines, and storage backends do not automatically support every combination. Draw separate same-request and cross-request timelines first, then identify the role LMCache actually plays in the chosen release. A feature appearing in another backend's example is not proof that your selected integration supports it.

task.zh: 为普通重复请求和 P/D 请求各画一条带状态生命周期的时序图。查证所选引擎的官方支持，标出可运行、需额外硬件、未支持的边；计算一次转移的字节预算。
task.en: Draw state-lifecycle sequence diagrams for repeated requests and P/D requests. Check official support for your chosen engine, label runnable, hardware-dependent, and unsupported edges, and calculate a transfer-byte budget.

evidence.zh: flows.md：两张时序图、兼容性来源与转移预算；有条件时附小规模链路日志。
evidence.en: flows.md with two sequence diagrams, compatibility sources, and a transfer budget; add small-scale link logs if available.

zh: 区分同一次请求转移和跨请求复用
每条实现路径都有具体版本或未验证标记
不把后端支持推导成所有引擎都支持
en: Separate same-request transfer from cross-request reuse
Attach a version or an unverified label to every implementation path
Do not generalize backend support to every engine

noGpu.zh: 使用事件表模拟 prefill 完成、缓存发布、decode 读取及超时；改变网络延迟观察关键路径，参数均标注为假设。
noGpu.en: Simulate prefill completion, publication, decode retrieval, and timeout in an event table. Vary network delay on the critical path and label every parameter as assumed.

lesson.zh: 命中率不能概括缓存服务的健康。需要同时看取回延迟、字节量、失败、队列和引擎端请求结果。指标缺失可能是尚未发生事件或导出模式不同，重启又会重置计数器。缓存不可用时究竟重算、拒绝还是超时，必须由当前集成实测确认；不能因为缓存被称为优化组件，就默认任何故障都不会影响推理。
lesson.en: Hit rate alone cannot describe cache-service health. Track retrieval latency, bytes, failures, queues, and engine-side request outcomes together. A missing metric may mean no event has occurred yet or a different export mode is active, while restarts reset counters. Whether unavailable caching triggers recomputation, rejection, or a timeout must be tested for the current integration. Calling a cache an optimization does not establish fault isolation. Inspect controlled failures with bounded traffic and record what happens to correctness as well as latency.

task.zh: 在隔离环境对缓存服务做一次受控停止或后端不可达实验，限定请求数与时长。记录错误、超时、是否回退、恢复后的首次请求及计数器变化，并写出操作恢复步骤。
task.en: In an isolated environment, stop the cache service once or make a test backend unavailable, with bounded requests and duration. Record errors, timeouts, fallback, the first recovered request, and counter changes, then write recovery steps.

evidence.zh: failure-report.md、故障前/中/后指标片段和恢复清单；只保留脱敏元数据。
evidence.en: failure-report.md, before/during/after metric extracts, and recovery steps; retain only redacted metadata.

zh: 故障有明确时间窗口和恢复动作
实际请求结果与缓存指标相互对应
区分未出现指标、计数器重置和真实零值
en: Define a bounded failure window and recovery action
Correlate request outcomes with cache metrics
Distinguish absent metrics, resets, and genuine zero values

noGpu.zh: 让本地模拟后端按固定序号抛出异常，测试超时与重算分支；明确这是恢复逻辑练习，不是引擎故障验证。
noGpu.en: Make a local mock backend fail at fixed request numbers and test timeout and recomputation branches. Label this as recovery-logic practice, not validation of the engine.

title.zh: 完成可审阅的缓存项目

lesson.zh: 好的缓存作品不只展示一个更低的延迟数字，还要交代成本、正确性、适用工作负载和没有收益的条件。让读者能从原始请求记录复算结论，比精美但不可复现的图更有价值。最后把固定环境、命中归因、容量估算、隔离边界与故障结果串联成一次工程决策，诚实区分已测事实、模型推导和下一步计划。
lesson.en: A strong cache project explains cost, correctness, suitable workloads, and conditions where caching does not help, rather than showing only a lower latency number. Readers should be able to recompute conclusions from raw request records. Connect the pinned environment, hit attribution, capacity estimates, isolation boundaries, and failure results into one engineering decision. Clearly distinguish measured facts, model-based deductions, and future work. This produces a useful discussion artifact for an interview or community review without overstating ten days of experience.

task.zh: 整理公开作品仓库：说明问题、复现步骤、原始脱敏数据、图表、正确性检查、至少一个负结果及版本限制。写一段建议，回答该工作负载是否应该启用 LMCache，以及需要先补什么证据。
task.en: Package a public portfolio with the problem, reproduction steps, redacted raw data, charts, correctness checks, at least one negative result, and version limits. Recommend whether this workload should enable LMCache and what evidence is still needed.

evidence.zh: 完整作品 README、实验目录与一页决策记录；可将作品链接加入聘枢求职材料。
evidence.en: A complete portfolio README, experiment directory, and one-page decision record; the portfolio link can support a JobHub application.

zh: 他人能识别哪些实验真实运行、哪些是模拟
至少一条结论能从原始数据复算
包含一个限制或负结果和后续验证计划
en: A reader can distinguish real runs from simulations
At least one conclusion is reproducible from raw data
Include a limitation or negative result and a validation plan

noGpu.zh: 提交完整的缓存身份测试、成本模型、故障模拟和集成设计；标题写明 CPU 设计实验，不虚构 GPU 性能或生产经验。
noGpu.en: Submit identity tests, cost models, failure simulations, and an integration design. Label the work as a CPU design lab and do not invent GPU performance or production experience.
